title: The Soot King's Hearth
summary: The ember that warms the village of Brindlecross has gone cold, and soot-black rats pour out of the old Forge vent. Descend, win over or defeat the goblins, and re-kindle the hearth.

scenes.title: The cold village
scenes.text: Talk to the elder Maren (Friendly), the shrine-keeper Oswin (Wary, he's hiding something), and the children who saw "a crown of smoke." Oswin took a sliver of the ember to sell. A DC 12 Insight Test spots the lie, and a Persuade or Intimidate Test gets a confession. The sliver gives a Boon later: it can re-kindle the hearth.

scenes.title: The vent
scenes.text: Descend 30 m. Make a group Athletics Test (DC 12) to climb down. Anyone who fails takes 1d6.

scenes.title: The Forge corridor
scenes.text: A dormant Hollow Sentry guards a door. A DC 14 Craft or Arcana Test deactivates it, and failure wakes it. A steam vent trap fills the hall: DC 12 Notice to spot it, or dodge vs DC 12 and take 2d6.

scenes.title: The goblin camp
scenes.text: Four Cinder Goblins serve the Soot King out of fear. Talking them over (Wary to Friendly) can turn them into allies or guides. Fighting them is a Hard encounter.

scenes.title: The Soot King's Hearth
scenes.text: A huge chamber with the cold ember in the center. The Soot King, a smoke elemental crowned with ash, feeds on the ember's last heat. Terrain: soot pits (Bane on movement), chains overhead (Athletics to swing across zones), and the cold ember itself. Twist: any hero can spend their Action touching the ember and making a Spirit Test (DC 14). Each success deals 10 radiant damage to the Soot King, and Oswin's sliver gives the Test a Boon. Victory: the ember reignites. Everyone levels up to 2 and gets a reward (a +1 weapon or an Ember Charm: once per session, recover 1 Ember).

hooks: Who taught a smoke elemental to eat embers? A soot-stained letter in the King's hoard is signed "the Ashen Choir."
Oswin's buyer is still in the city of Lanthorn, waiting for an ember sliver.
